fusions.name: Tangle Spray
fusions.desc: Looses 5 strands at once, spread apart, each dealing 2 damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Draw the Line
fusions.desc: A whipping kick that deals 12 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Trip Wire
fusions.desc: Strings a snare of strands at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, then deals 16 damage to each of the first 3 enemies to tread within 2 tiles and leaves them [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wound Tight
fusions.desc: Every hit you land binds a strand to that enemy, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: a blow strikes it for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
